newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline jumps $8, tracking U.S. gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline jumps $8, tracking U.S. gains.

text.p: NWE gasoline markets jumped sharply higher on Monday despite the absence of many European traders due to a holiday.

Premium unleaded barges traded at $208 and $209.25 a tonne, with the market keen to catch up with sharp gains made by NYMEX unleaded gasoline futures which climbed nearly two cents a gallon on Friday.
Barges traded on Friday between $201 and $202.
"It's just catching up with the rest of the market," said one trader.
June swaps were pegged $6.00 a tonne higher at $209/$210.
